message: Node.js 20 is deprecated. The following actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24: actions/cache@v4, actions/checkout@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4, softprops/action-gh-release@v2. For more information see: https://github.blog/changelog/2025-09-19-deprecation-of-node-20-on-github-actions-runners/
Due to capacity constraints, jobs targeting macOS arm64 runners may experience longer queue times.
